name: MitoRush
summary:
**Move to the beat. Bring your people.**

MitoRush™ turns music into a workout. Crystals fly at you on the beat; you hit them with your hands, dodge, duck, and — when you choose — kick and sprint. Two ways to play:

- **Flow** — full-body movement to the music.
- **Boxing** — punches and stances; tracks can call a stance change mid-song.

**Your body, your settings.** Four difficulties. A five-step *Targets* ladder from hands-only to everything. Seated play. A calibration that places targets for your height
